title: Bookshelf – Self-hosted eBook library that runs on object storage
summary: Bookshelf is a self-hosted eBook library application that leverages object storage (like S3 or MinIO) to manage and serve digital books, allowing users to host their personal book collections on cloud infrastructure.
problem_solved: Provides a lightweight, self-hosted alternative to cloud eBook services like Kindle or Calibre Web, enabling users to store books on any S3-compatible object storage.
why_valuable: It gives users full control over their eBook collection while utilizing cost-effective and scalable object storage solutions, with the simplicity of self-hosting.
